objective: Restore synchronized operational state after bounded ground-space divergence without reactivating a compromised epoch or relying on hidden peer-state knowledge.
assumptions: Recovery-control messages are authenticated by an established cryptographic core abstracted as an allowed recovery authority.
The recovery authority counter survives endpoint rollback and is not derived from the compromised operational traffic key.
The adversary becomes passive for a finite interval long enough for the configured bounded-delivery condition.
At most one recovery candidate is pending at each endpoint.
Candidate and activation-receipt retention are bounded by transmission count and contact lifetime.

no_hidden_oracle_rule.ground_proposal: max(ground active epoch, recovery-authority epoch floor) + 1
no_hidden_oracle_rule.meaning: The ground does not read simulator-only spacecraft state; the spacecraft returns the selected forward epoch in RECOVERY_RESPONSE.

message_flow.effect: reserve one bounded recovery attempt; no candidate key becomes authoritative
select a target epoch above spacecraft state and bind an opaque candidate key reference
activate the exact selected candidate at the spacecraft and retain a bounded activation receipt
activate the exact selected candidate at the ground; exact commit retries may re-emit confirmation
verify command acceptance, telemetry evidence, convergence, and rejection of compromised state before SUCCESS

bounded_controls.replay_cache: bounded by implementation profile; abstract model records message identifiers

provisional_outcomes.SUCCESS: endpoints converge, fresh test command is accepted, status telemetry is received, and active candidate is not marked compromised
provisional_outcomes.INDETERMINATE: endpoints converge but test or status evidence is incomplete
provisional_outcomes.EXPIRED: bounded delivery is exhausted before either endpoint activates the candidate
provisional_outcomes.SECURE_DEGRADED: spacecraft activation occurred but confirmation budget expired; recovery control remains modeled, so permanent LOCKED is not asserted
provisional_outcomes.DIVERGED: bindings or state are incompatible and no provisional recovery transition completed
provisional_outcomes.AVAILABLE_UNSAFE: the active candidate or recovery authority is marked attacker-known or compromised
provisional_outcomes.LOCKED: reserved for a modeled state in which no authorized recovery transition remains

mandatory_external_review_stop_points: before changing the Phase 05 oracle candidate to ACCEPTED or FROZEN
before labeling T1 as the final treatment rather than a provisional candidate
before freezing the final experiment protocol or parameter ranges
before interpreting simulation results as evidence of post-compromise security
before implementing real cryptographic primitives or claiming protocol conformance
before NOS3/cFS integration intended to support publication claims
before manuscript submission or external security claims
